==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[Cassius]] by the pond Northwest of [[Lumbridge]] {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Gillie Groats]] {{Chat option|3Can you share what makes your cows so productive?}}
*Speak to [[Seth Groats]]
*Search the [[shelves (The Ides of Milk)|shelves]] in Seth's farmhouse for [[The groats principles]] book
*Return to [[Cassius]] with the book, receiving a [[Milk sample]] from him
*Drink the [[Milk sample]] in front of [[Cassius]], who will give you a second [[Milk sample]] to take to [[Duke Horacio]]
*Speak to [[Duke Horacio]] in [[Lumbridge Castle]]
*Speak to [[Gillie Groats]]
*Drink the [[Milk sample]] in front of [[Gillie Groats]], who will offer you a permit for dealing with the [[Brutus|bull]]
*Open the pen in the north-east corner of the cow farm and fight the [[Brutus|bull]]
*Speak to [[Gillie Groats]]
*Speak to [[Cassius]]
*Speak to [[Gillie Groats]] for rewards.}}
